_comment: Canonical OperatorSession document shape. The Gateway is the authority: OperatorSessionService in internal/services/gateway/operator_session_service.go creates, deactivates, and queries this document in the operator_sessions collection of ztd.db when an Operator (ztdo) authenticates via mTLS. Gateway services look sessions up by ID (for example sessionExists in internal/services/pubsub/platform_enrollment_handlers.go). A field mismatch breaks Operator authentication, session binding, and command routing.
_consumers: gateway internal services (operator_session_service.go, pubsub platform enrollment handlers)

operator_session._description: Authenticated Operator session. Created when ztdo successfully authenticates with the client via mTLS. One session per Operator connection.

session_type.description: Session type discriminator. See status.json session.type.

user_id.description: User ID who owns this Operator session.

organization_id.description: Organization ID. Equals user_id for single-user orgs.

operator_id.description: Operator document ID this session is bound to.

is_active.description: Whether the session is currently active.

absolute_expires_at.description: Absolute expiry timestamp. Session is invalid after this time regardless of activity.

idle_expires_at.description: Idle expiry timestamp. Session is invalid if no activity occurs before this time.

last_activity.description: Timestamp of the last session activity (heartbeat, command, etc.).

login_method.description: Authentication method used to create this session. See status.json auth.login_method.
